id_string.description: Stable kebab-case id. Content ids are TEXT primary keys in SQLite so re-imports upsert instead of duplicating.

source_page.description: Page of the lesson in the source book. null ONLY in demo packs.

summary_ar.description: Short lesson summary in the curator's own words, grounded in the source. Never presented as quoted textbook text unless it is verbatim and marked as such.

correct_answer.description: REQUIRED for true_false ('صح' or 'خطأ'), fill_blank and equation. For mcq it must be absent or equal to options[correct_option_index].

correct_option_index.description: REQUIRED for type=mcq: 0-based index into options. Must be < options.length (checked by the importer).

difficulty.description: 1 = سهل (تذكّر/فهم), 2 = متوسط (تطبيق), 3 = صعب (تحليل/تركيب). Set by the curator against the book, not guessed by an AI.

explanation.description: REQUIRED. Why the answer is correct, grounded in the source. Shown after every answer — this is where the learning happens.

lesson_id.description: Lesson the question belongs to. Unit-level / boss / exam questions use the unit's '<unit_id>-review' lesson, which the pack must define. Never null in the DB.

media_ref.description: Reserved. MUST be null in v1: content packs carry text only. Diagrams are drawn procedurally in code (CustomPainter), never shipped as image/audio files in a pack.

options.description: REQUIRED for type=mcq (exactly one correct option, given by correct_option_index). Optional for other types; ignored by the importer when absent.

source_page.description: Page of the question / its topic in the source book. null ONLY in demo packs; the importer REJECTS null source_page in non-demo packs.

type.description: mcq = multiple choice; true_false = صح/خطأ; fill_blank = أكمل; match = اربط; ordering = رتّب; equation = أكمل المعادلة / حلّ. v1 games use mcq and true_false first; other types are accepted by the schema and stored, and games enable them as their renderers land.

source_string.description: Provenance string, shown to the learner. Never empty, never invented.

icon_key.description: Key of a code-drawn icon (e.g. 'maths', 'atom', 'flask'). NOT a file path — v1 ships no image assets for icons.

source_page.description: First page of the unit in the source book. null ONLY in demo packs.

description: Schema for an ABQARIYA offline content pack (Yemeni textbook content imported by a teacher/curator). Every question and every content row must carry source provenance. A pack whose source is demo content MUST set pack.is_demo=true and use source 'demo — not Yemeni curriculum' on every row. Real curriculum packs MUST have is_demo=false, a real book source, and source_page >= 1 on every question. See docs/CONTENT_IMPORT.md.

format.description: Fixed format marker. Any other value is rejected.

curriculum_year.description: e.g. '2025-2026'. Required for non-demo packs (enforced by the importer, not by this schema alone).

id.description: Stable pack id, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. 'demo-pack-v1' or 'ye-physics-3sec-2025'.

is_demo.description: true ONLY for the clearly-labelled demo set. The app shows demo content behind a 'تجريبي — ليس من المنهج' badge and never mixes it with curriculum stats.

source.description: Provenance of the whole pack. Demo packs: exactly 'demo — not Yemeni curriculum'. Real packs: full book citation, e.g. 'كتاب الفيزياء — الصف الثالث الثانوي العلمي، الجمهورية اليمنية، طبعة 2024'.

version.description: Schema version of this file. The importer only accepts version 1 in v1 of the app.

title: ABQARIYA Content Pack
